desc: The Pit of 100 Trials in co-op on one computer (the second player on the partner, turned on by the run and put back after): asked for 700 frames after the warp (TTYD_MODERUN_PITCOOP=2), down the pipe to floor 1; on each of floors 1 and 2 the floor's enemy walked into and fought (the input's fight: a field battle, so its defeat counts and the exit pipe rises; the auto-battler with god mode), Mario walked (jumping) onto the risen pipe in the middle and down into it; on floor 3, Leave as the Settings tab's button does: the run over at floor 3, Mario back in Rogueport; control back with nothing lent, the file's partners, badges, key items and story as they were (its Star Points and level are its own: the Pit is the file's). No Mover while TTYD_MODERUN_PITCOOP runs (one floor in twenty has him instead of an enemy, its pipe his to open)
log_must: \[moderun\] Pit in co-op asked: 2 floors, then leave
\[moderun\] Pit of 100 Trials in co-op started
\[input\] frame \d+: fight enemy: beaten after \d+ frames[\s\S]*\[input\] frame \d+: fight enemy: beaten after
\[moderun\] Pit of 100 Trials in co-op: leave asked \(in the field\)
\[modes\] leave: Pit of 100 Trials in co-op$
\[moderun\] Pit of 100 Trials in co-op over after
\[moderun\] control back after Pit of 100 Trials in co-op: .*lending 0
\[moderun\] check after Pit of 100 Trials in co-op: stats \w+, partners same, badges same, items \w+, key items same, coins \d+ -> \d+, star points \d+ -> \d+, story same
